title: Reading § 2-207 as a sequence of questions
shortTitle: Reading § 2-207 as a sequence of questions
summary: The chapter organizes the statute around formation by writings, formation by conduct, and determination of terms.
notes: Begin with the communications and the identity of the offeror. Ask whether the response is a definite and timely expression of acceptance, whether a clear condition requires assent, and whether assent occurred. If the writings fail, examine the parties’ conduct. Apply the term rule corresponding to the formation route. Dorton’s remand, C. Itoh’s conduct contract, and the notes on oral agreements prevent treating the statute as only a contest between two pieces of paper.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 269–284. Open assigned page 269.
